name: Lock In a Consistent Wake-Up Time
equipment: An alarm clock or phone alarm
instructions: Set your alarm for the same time every morning this week, weekends included -- a fixed wake time anchors your whole sleep cycle.
Get out of bed within a few minutes of the alarm rather than snoozing repeatedly, which fragments the last stretch of sleep.
Expect bedtime to naturally become easier within 1-2 weeks as your body adjusts to the fixed wake time.
End tonight with the wind-down meditation as usual.
